notes.title: VaatiVidya Eitr Demo Preview
notes.content:
For those of you that missed it, check out this video of VaatiVidya playing the PSX Eitr Demo!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=a-YatMGBqq0

I would also like to take this moment to thank all of you for your on-going feedback and support, suggestions, criticism and general comments all are helping us to make Eitr the game we want it to be!

Regards,
- David (Derity) Wright
